name: hcapp_copyEventRsvps
description: Copies RSVP records from one event to another. Only copies RSVPs for users who are not already in the target event (LEFT OUTER JOIN prevents duplicates). Returns a count of copied RSVPs as an adHoc row, then delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

parameters.name: fromEvent
parameters.description: Source event to copy RSVPs from.

parameters.name: toEvent
parameters.description: Destination event to copy RSVPs into.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format for null userId, null fromEvent, null toEvent (errorType=2), and auth failure (errorType=3). See other SP contracts for column details.

rowsets.name: AdHocCopyResult
rowsets.description: Single row confirming the copy operation.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: 'Copied N RSVPs' where N is @@ROWCOUNT from the INSERT.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — copies RsvpState, IsHare, VirginVisitorType, KennelId from source event for each user not already at target event
EXEC hcapp_syncEventAdminData — returns multiple result sets for @toEvent
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
